items.desc: Centralized multi-tier management: Super Admin, Organization Admin, and Madrasa In-Charge scoping. Controls branch profiles, academic terms, and staff assignments.
Comprehensive student admissions, demographic records, parent mapping, auto-generated login credentials with printable credential slips, and status controls.
Teacher profiles, permission templates, role-scoped class assignments, subject allocations, and staff communication directories.
Structured Islamic and regular syllabus management, class definitions, subject mapping, and academic hierarchy visualization.
Daily session-wise and class-wise attendance register with instant marking (Present/Absent/Late), historical attendance logs, and student summary cards.
Annual academic progression engine: batch promote or demote students between classes with full historical audit trails.
Bulk onboarding of students, parents, and staff via CSV with schema validation, duplicate detection, import summaries, and error logs.
Interactive visual tree charts showing organization structure, campus branches, classrooms, and assigned teachers.
Targeted in-app notifications and alerts filtered by role (all users, teachers only, parents only, or specific madrasas).
Role-scoped reporting tables: attendance summaries, student rosters, enrollment stats, and institutional metrics.
Fast, responsive Progressive Web Application + Android APK/AAB build through Ionic Capacitor for smartphones and desktop browsers.
Configured on dedicated project (deendesk-290526): Cloud Firestore realtime database, Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage for photo uploads, and SSL Hosting.

customSections.title: 3. PERMANENT OWNERSHIP VS MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION — COST BENEFIT ANALYSIS

bullets.text: Under the original SaaS subscription model at approx. Rs.5,000/month, your organization would pay Rs.60,000 every year (Rs.1,80,000 over 3 years). With this ownership buyout, monthly subscription fees are permanently 100% eliminated.
By investing a single buyout balance of Rs.35,000, your organization secures full perpetual software rights, unrestricted usage across all madrasa branches, and complete independence.

Moving to direct Google Firebase usage billing (estimated at only Rs.6,000 – Rs.8,000 per year for Firestore reads/writes/storage) saves your organization over Rs.52,000 every year compared to recurring monthly subscriptions.
Firebase billing is directly connected to the client's payment card. There are no middlemen markups or hidden server fees—you pay Google strictly for what your madrasas actually consume.
All student records, parent contact details, attendance archives, and madrasa finances remain securely hosted under your own dedicated cloud account with full export and backup privileges.
The initial engineering sum of Rs.55,000 and the transition month fee of Rs.5,000 are formally credited and acknowledged in this agreement.
The net payable amount of Rs.35,000 INR is due upon signing of this agreement to finalize complete ownership transfer.
Flow will not charge any monthly maintenance, per-student, or recurring software licensing fees post-settlement.
Flow will guide the client in securely linking the madrasa management credit/debit card to the Google Cloud / Firebase console (deendesk-290526) with automated budget alert caps.
Includes routine framework compatibility, security rule audits, and bug fixes for 12 months from the buyout date.
Dedicated WhatsApp and phone support via +91 8903424281 during business hours (Mon–Sat, 9 AM – 6 PM IST).
Any new custom features outside the current scope (e.g. specialized exam grading cards, automated SMS gateways, biometric machine integrations) will be quoted separately on request.
Flow guarantees that all databases, student files, and backups are the exclusive intellectual and confidential property of the client.
